																		Education Qualification

																		
																			Assistant Environmental Engineer AEE:  Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemical Technology, Civil Engineering, or Environmental Engineering from a university established by law in India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government. This also includes AMIE (Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers, India) in the branches of Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Environmental Engineering as a valid equivalent qualification.
																		

																		 

																		
																			Assistant Scientific Officer ASO: Candidates should possess either a Doctorate (Ph.D.) in Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, or Biochemistry from a university established by law in India (or equivalent recognized qualification) along with a minimum of three years of experience in the field of Environment, Pollution Control, or Public Health. Alternatively, candidates may hold a Master's degree in Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, or Biochemistry from a recognized Indian university (including deemed universities or institutes established by Central or State Government) or equivalent qualification, accompanied by at least five years of relevant experience in Environment, Pollution Control, or Public Health.
